He used violence, threats, detained ID, forced labor. Could be "非法拘禁罪" (illegal detention) and "强迫交易"? But forced labor is separate.

He also caused death: homicide? He beat victim, forced labor, victim later drowned. Could be "故意杀人罪" (intentional homicide) or "过失致人死亡"? The facts: He beat victim, forced labor, victim later drowned. The prosecution says "故意伤害他人身体健康，并造成他人轻伤的后果". Also "致一人死亡". Might be "故意伤害罪" (with result of death) which under Chinese law is "故意伤害致死罪" (Article 234). That is a separate crime.

But here there are distinct offenses: forced labor (multiple victims) and intentional injury resulting in death (one victim). Also possibly "非法拘禁罪". But forced labor includes deprivation of liberty? Under Chinese law, forced labor is separate. The acts of beating, threats, detaining ID could be illegal detention. The victims forced to labor: three victims forced labor. That is forced labor crime. The death victim also forced labor, but death leads to separate homicide. So list two crimes: 强迫劳动; 故意伤害致死.
